description: Total trades are at least the number of satisfactory trades.
explanation: Satisfactory trades are a counted subset of all recorded trades, and preprocessing explicitly enforces this containment.

description: Total trades are at least trades initiated in the last year.
explanation: Trades initiated during the recent-year window are included in the total trade count; preprocessing explicitly enforces this subset relationship.

description: Total trades are at least revolving trades currently carrying a balance.
explanation: Revolving trades with a balance are a subset of the applicant's recorded trades, and preprocessing explicitly enforces this containment.

description: Total trades are at least installment trades currently carrying a balance.
explanation: Installment trades with a balance are a subset of the applicant's recorded trades, and preprocessing explicitly enforces this containment.

description: Trades delinquent at least 60 days are at least as numerous as trades delinquent at least 90 days.
explanation: A trade reaching the 90-days-or-worse delinquency threshold necessarily also reaches the 60-days-or-worse threshold, so the latter count contains the former.

description: Total trades are at least the number of trades with high bankcard or national-trade utilization.
explanation: Qualifying high-utilization trades are counted trades in the applicant's broader recorded trade population.

description: Six-month inquiry count is at least the six-month inquiry count excluding the immediately preceding seven days.
explanation: Excluding a seven-day subset from the six-month inquiry window cannot increase the count.

description: The combined recorded counts of total trades and severely delinquent or derogatory trades are nonnegative.
explanation: Both columns represent counts of trades; when bureau counts are present, their sum cannot be negative, and this weaker whole-count relationship avoids assuming the ever-derogatory count is a subset of the currently recorded total.

description: The average trade age is at least months since the most recently opened trade.
explanation: The most recently opened trade is the youngest trade in the file, so an average trade age cannot be below that lower endpoint when the ages are observed.

description: Revolving trades carrying a balance are at least the number of high-utilization trades.
explanation: A trade counted as high utilization is a revolving/bankcard-type trade with a balance and is therefore contained in the revolving trades-with-balance count.

description: Total trades are at least the sum of revolving and installment trades currently carrying a balance.
explanation: Revolving and installment trade categories are distinct account types, and each balance-bearing category is a subset of the total recorded trades.
